title: Your library, concepts and terrain connected

features.title: One companion for worlds and encounters
features.description: Shape a single evolving plan using text or voice, preview proposed batches on your terrain, then keep, retry or adjust them. Conversations stay with each saved project.

features.title: Keep your designs visually consistent
features.description: Use up to four active reference images, refine a retained concept or start fresh, and choose the main thumbnail. Approve retained views before submitting them to Meshy. Inspect the actual returned model in 3D.

features.title: Build from your local library
features.description: Find available personal assets and saved encounters in the terrain library shelf. Character and scenery designs support D&D, model railway, racing and other purposes.

features.title: Understand and protect local storage
features.description: See storage used by campaigns, models, official packs, recovery and caches. Export or restore your personal library and remove temporary library cache files without deleting saved designs.
